title: Post Mortem Tissue Donation of Pediatric Tumor Tissues and Cells
official: Post Mortem Tissue Donation of Pediatric Tumor Tissues and Cells
summary: The objective of this study is to utilize all donated pediatric tumor tissues and cells obtained from autopsy to prospectively develop novel patient derived orthotopic xenograft (PDOX) mouse models as well as in vitro cell culture model systems for pediatric cancers, and also provide tissue samples to other researchers and organizations (eg, CBTN, DIPG Registry, COG).

interventions.name: Collection of post mortem tissue donation

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Pediatric patients with cancer and non-cancer tumor types (solid, liquid, neuro-oncology)
* Signed consent for post mortem tissue donation and autopsy

Exclusion Criteria:

* Signed consent for post mortem tissue donation and autopsy not obtained
sponsor: Ann & Robert H Lurie Children's Hospital of Chicago
